deployCompose:
version: "3.9"

x-logging: &x-logging
  logging:
    driver: json-file
    options:
      max-size: "10m"
      max-file: "5"

services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:2.11
    container_name: appwrite-traefik
    <<: *x-logging
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - --log.level=INFO
      - --providers.docker=true
